scope: Independent source-only review of the four-line IconName registry fix. No implementation edits, Cargo commands, cache operations, app launch, benchmarks, or hardware checks.
summary: No source-level performance blocker found for the affected toolbar flow. Two unit variants expand existing derive dispatch and registry enumeration by two entries. The All Icons component preview consequently gains two entries; toolbar construction, SVG bytes, loading, rendering, and cache keys are unchanged.

evidence.observed: git diff --numstat reports 4 additions and 0 removals in crates/icons/src/icons.rs only. AndroidStudioAdd and AndroidStudioClose are unit variants, each with an explicit Strum serialization. The Debug/PartialEq/Eq/Copy/Clone/EnumIter/EnumString/IntoStaticStr/Serialize/Deserialize derive set is unchanged. A source count finds 301 variants before and 303 after.
evidence.assessment: Generated dispatch code or tables can grow by two alternatives; no new lookup algorithm, dynamically initialized registry, payload field, or allocation-bearing variant is introduced. Both counts already exceed 256 variants and remain below 65536, so the change crosses neither usual discriminator-width threshold. Actual enum layout, binary-size growth, derive expansion, compiler timing, and instruction costs were not measured.

evidence.observed: Asset inclusion already covers icons/**/* independently of IconName. The asset source, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, and both SVG blobs are identical between base and reviewed commit. The diff adds no initialization function, preload, task, listener, or new asset.
evidence.assessment: No new eager icon loading or startup allocation is introduced by the registry additions. Additional static generated metadata may exist; exact executable size and resident memory were not measured.

evidence.observed: The toolbar close icon still calls Icon::from_path with icons/android-studio-close.svg. Add-action test fixtures retain icons/android-studio-add.svg. Icon::from_path treats icons/ paths as Embedded sources, bypassing IconName parsing and IconName::path. The toolbar, Icon component, SVG element, SVG renderer, and asset source have unchanged Git blobs. paint_svg retains its path-and-size sprite-atlas key and on-demand get_or_insert_with rendering.
evidence.assessment: The changed registry adds no work to the existing toolbar render path and does not change its cache keys, rasterization inputs, layout, or asset-byte cost.

evidence.observed: Repository-wide Git searches identify test_all_icons_exist iterating IconName, test_no_dangling_icons parsing file stems, and the Icon component All Icons preview using <IconName as strum::IntoEnumIterator>::iter(). The preview creates a named icon tile for each variant and retains its image cache. IconName::path continues to format icons/{file_stem}.svg into Arc<str>.
evidence.assessment: test_all_icons_exist gains two path/existence checks. The directory enumeration in test_no_dangling_icons is unchanged and can now parse the two existing stems. Opening the All Icons component preview produces two additional tiles, path/name allocations, and possible on-demand SVG/cache entries. This expected bounded preview cost is not an affected-toolbar regression; its runtime cost was not measured.

evidence.observed: The only explicit per-variant Strum mappings are the two unique hyphenated names android-studio-add and android-studio-close. All other names use the global snake_case policy, so they cannot collide with these hyphenated names. git diff --check succeeded with no output; git ls-files --unmerged returned no entries; the changed source contains no conflict markers.
evidence.assessment: No source naming collision or current worktree merge conflict found. Exact parser behavior remains subject to compilation/test verification owned by the parent task.
